description: This is a CLI script for the 'universalinit' project, providing command-line interface functionalities for initializing various project types, parsing parameters, and retrieving build/run info. It manages user inputs, creates project configurations, and interacts with template factories to generate project scaffolds.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Data class representing initialization information for project templates, including commands, environment settings, scripts, and files involved in project setup.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration data class encapsulating project parameters such as name, version, description, author, type, output path, and custom parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration or class method to parse project type strings into standardized project type representations.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating template instances and performing project initialization based on configuration.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary, inferring types like bool, int, float.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Constructs a ProjectConfig instance from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig instance for retrieving template info without full user input.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a given base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Serializes TemplateInitInfo into a dictionary, converting init file paths to absolute paths.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Formats and prints JSON output indicating success/failure and associated message, including template configuration if available.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a given project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles retrieving and outputting the run command for a specified project type based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point that parses command-line arguments, handles project initialization or run command retrieval, and manages flow control.

ctags.name: output_json

ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
